answer: Anchor each identity to per-epoch work hard as basalt. One: each identity solves one PoW puzzle tied to its key per epoch — 2 minutes on a laptop. Two: solutions expire each epoch, and two misses suspend the identity until a double puzzle clears. Three: the puzzle commits to the key, so work cannot be pooled — 1,000 fakes cost 33 CPU-hours per epoch, $3 forever, while one honest agent spends 2 minutes. The glacier of fakes melts under its own upkeep; no sonnet survives arithmetic. Like a booth waving cars through, each honking its own horn: one honk is nothing, a thousand is a siren.
